findings: B1: the solo_founder category modifier opens signup, and this product offers none. The companion argues the absence at length in its sections 1.1, 2.4 and 2.5, and the brief carries the argument as product truth. The two roles the pattern row wants are present as Visitor and Maintainer; only the signup half deviates, and the deviation is recorded in 00-decisions.md.

C7: the six judged sections join at 59627 characters, well past the 9000-character join slice, so the judge reads the head of Core features and none of the later sections. G33 reports this as past-slice and fails nothing: the brief has no length limit, the graded rules are front-loaded inside Core features, and judge_score never reaches reward.

D5: the brief asks a first-time visitor once about non-essential storage, and the companion's section 31.3 says the site sets no cookie needing a banner. The companion contradicts itself here: its section 20.6 requires the documentation version selection to persist across sessions, which is exactly such a store. The brief resolves the contradiction rather than inverting a settled source, the drawn launch surface requires the choice, and the resolution is recorded in 00-decisions.md under Divergences.

S2: 01-PRD.md carries ten must-have features rather than three to six. reference/G G.2.1 raises the cap to six to ten when a companion document is supplied, and every one of the ten is graded by a workflow, a pytest test or a rubric criterion.

S5: 04-uiux-brief.md carries no hex palette, no pixel type pairs and no millisecond motion values. generate_instruction.md section 4, 'The number rule, DECIDED', and source_lint.py A5 both forbid those values anywhere in the emitted corpus, and the supplied authoring guidelines require intent in place of values. S5 predates that decision; the axes it asks for are all present as direction.
B1: the solo_founder category modifier opens signup and this product offers none. Same finding as QC_instruction B1, argued in the companion's sections 1.1 and 2.5 and recorded in 00-decisions.md.

CMP-011 and CMP-022 contradict each other: CMP-011 wants the compose file free of published host ports, CMP-022 requires the main service to set ports. Only main publishes and it publishes the container-internal port the App Contract pins; no sidecar publishes anything, which is the concurrency hazard CMP-011 exists for.

CMP-020 wants main to exist solely for depends_on, and CMP-022 requires main to carry extra_hosts and ports as well. The file follows CMP-022, the newer rule, and main carries nothing beyond those three keys.

CMP-008: the minio-init service is backed by no slot of its own. It provisions the bucket for the declared storage slot and holds no state, and the declared storage provider minio has a service of that exact name beside it.

DEP-011 is skipped under environment_mode separate; DEP-016 and DEP-017 apply only to a compiled language and this task declares python; ARCH-002 and ARCH-003 apply only when a base image is pinned by digest and this one is pinned by tag; BP-004 applies only where a source supplies a checksum; BLD-004 applies only where application source is copied, and the agent writes it after the image is built.

RC-12: three criteria grade a fact a page-driven pytest test also observes. R11 names the contrast bar that test_page_body_text_meets_the_contrast_bar measures, R16 names the grab cursor, and R26 names the two-object budget and the hidden-tab pause. Each is kept because the criterion judges the whole surface while the test samples one element, and channel_lint G28 permits pytest and the rubric to share a ui item; the browser lane cites none of the three, so G29 holds.

BENCH-003, BENCH-005 and INT-007 cannot be decided: each reads the declared difficulty, and TAX-010 requires difficulty to be the empty placeholder. BENCH-004 is decidable and passes: tokens_expected is 7500000, inside the 200000 to 8000000 range, and the Standard resource tier is exact.
BENCH-002 applies only to a trivial task; SIGN-001, SIGN-002 and SIGN-003 are deprecated in favour of SIGN-004, which passes; INST-007 applies only when instruction.md is absent.
